name: grp-mcp
description: Drive an Acumatica ERP instance from Claude: read, write, run processes and diagnose failures across the five APIs Acumatica actually has. Talks to your own instance directly - nothing is proxied, and credentials never leave your machine. Writes are off per profile until you enable them, and a clean 'ok' is never trusted: writes are read back and anything unconfirmed is reported as unverified. Runs on Windows, macOS and Linux from PyPI through uvx, so it needs uv installed - 'winget install astral-sh.uv' on Windows, 'brew install uv' on a Mac. Run tools\Edit-Connections.cmd once to create your connections file; it lands in %USERPROFILE%\grp-mcp (~/.grp-mcp on macOS and Linux), outside AppData where a Claude app update cannot delete it, and the server finds it with no environment variable set. LATEST (0.81.0-rc29): editing or deleting a row in a table on an older-style Acumatica screen now actually saves. It had been going through the motions - reporting success, with nothing written to the database - because the screen needs two steps, prepare then save, and only the first was ever sent. This affected every such edit and delete, and it was hard to spot because a change that is prepared but not saved looks exactly like a change that was not needed. Tested on five different kinds of table against a live system, checking the database each time rather than trusting what the tool reported. Full history in docs/CHANGELOG.md.
